Chowkhamba Sanskrit Series Office
------------------------------------------
One of the biggest publishing houses of books on Indology, this firm was established in A. D. 1892 at वाराणसी by Bābu Haridās Gupta (A. D. 1868-1908). It was named छोwखम्ब सन्स्क्रित् सेरिएस् ओड़्ड़िचे.
As per the avowed purpose, it started publishing rare Sanskrit manuscripts to meet the demands of the scholarly world. This helped in the rejuvenation of Sanskrit studies including interest in research work.
It has maintained an unbroken schedule of publications over the years. It has to its credit more than a dozen series such as:
Chowkhamba Sanskrit Series (A. D. 1898)
Kāśī Sanskrit Series (A. D. 1915)
Haridās Sanskrit Series (A. D. 1927)
In A. D. 1954, three new series were added on आयुर्वेद, Rāṣṭrabhāṣā (Hindi) and Sanskrit.
The subjects so far covered include the वेदस्, उपनिषद्स्, पुराणस्, धर्म-śāstras, अस्त्रोलोग्य्, आयुर्वेद, grammar, history and philosophy.
Hindi and English translations of such works have also been brought out.
One of the biggest achievements has been the bringing out a new impression of Vācaspatyam, a Sanskrit-Sanskrit dictionary in five volumes in A. D. 1992.
